 Hon'Ble Smt Justice Tirumala Devi Eada

Judgment:
(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice Abhinand Kumar Shavili)

Aggrieved by the judgment and decree dated 23.01.2006 passed in O.P.No.35 of 2001 by the Senior Civil Judge, Nirmal, Adilabad District, the present Appeal has been filed by the appellant-Referring Officer.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge, Nirmal, Adilabad District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned Government Pleader for Appeals appearing for the appellant and Sri V.Manohar Rao, learned counsel appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 5, 9 to 11, 14 to 17, 19, 21 to 32, 34, 38, 43 to 55.
3.

It is the case of the appellant that the land to an extent of Ac.23.32 guntas situated at Mandapalli Village, Khanapur Mandal, was acquired for Saraswathi Canal under Sri Ram Sagar Project from the respondents in pursuance of the Notification issued under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (for short 'the Act').
The Land Acquisition Officer has passed an Award on 19.06.2000 and awarded compensation @ Rs.30,000/- per acre.

Being not satisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer, the respondents sought reference under Section 18 of the Act and the Land Acquisition Officer has referred the case to the Reference Court and the same was numbered as O.P.No.35 of 2001.
Without appreciating any of the contentions raised by the appellant, the Reference Court vide Judgment 23.01.2006 has enhanced the compensation from Rs.30,000/- per acre to Rs.48,000/- per acre.
Hence, the present appeal.

4. Learned Government Pleader appearing for the appellant had contended that appropriate orders be passed in the appeal by setting aside the judgment and decree dated 23.01.2006 passed by the Reference Court in O.P.No.35 of 2001.

5. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent Nos.1 to 5, 9 to 11, 14 to 17, 19, 21 to 32, 34, 38, 43 to 55 had contended that the Reference Court has relied upon Ex.B1-sale deed, dated 23.12.1998,
which is evidencing sale of Ac.0.37 guntas of land in Sy.No.363/AA of Mandapalli Village @
Rs.48,000/- per acre.

Based on the evidence of RW3 and Ex.B1-sale deed, the Reference Court came to the conclusion that the lands covered under Ex.B1 are similar in nature and fertility with the acquired lands and Ex.B1 was also considered by the Land Acquisition Officer during the Award enquiry and the Reference Court has rightly enhanced the compensation in favour of the Special Deputy Collector L.A, vs Satyanarayana Chary on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4733171/
1 respondents.

entities.text: Special Deputy Collector L.A, vs Satyanarayana Chary
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, there are no merits in the appeal and the same is liable to be dismissed.

6. Having considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel on either side, this Court is of the view that the Reference Court has rightly enhanced the compensation based on Ex.B1-sale deed, which is three months prior to the notification and as the lands covered under Ex.B1 and the acquired lands are in the same vicinity at a distance of 20 metres.
The recitals in Ex.B1 reveals that the sale consideration took place @ Rs.48,000/- per acre.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to interfere with the order passed by the Reference Court.
7. Accordingly, the Appeal is dismissed.
No costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

JUSTICE TIRUMALA DEVI EADA Date: 12.03.2025 rkk Special Deputy Collector L.A, vs Satyanarayana Chary on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4733171/
